accepted_corrections: P0 is a numerical qualification stop, not a falsification of semantic function
Same nominal delta does not fix actual endpoints or clean trajectory
Functional terminal replay must preserve tied input embedding and include RMSNorm/head/tanh softcap; rounded logits cannot be upcast to recover signal
CI containing one is not equivalence; zero-denominator ratios avoided
Local FP64 audit does not certify full 12B output
Coalition size and total delivered write energy must be separated; DET vs OUT is required
Natural coordinate donors do not guarantee a natural joint hybrid state
Do not silently drop confirmation coordinates or interpolate a nonmonotone k curve
Head FP32 alone does not rule out trunk numerical effects
Known content/identifier and precision-floor results lower standalone novelty
deferred_or_excluded: old four-coordinate signed decomposition as standalone paper
head localization or BF16/FP32 comparison alone
placebo reproducing a magnitude alone as proof all neuron effects are artifacts
donor-specific downstream-path project until a reliable selective natural signal exists
